articles.title: SpaceX set to launch Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
articles.description: SpaceX plans to launch Google tensor processing units into orbit on Planet Labs satellites.

articles.title: Oil prices rise as Chinese refiners reportedly ban October fuel exports; Brent crude back above $100
articles.description: It comes after a report that Chinese refiners suspended October fuel exports to protect domestic supplies.

articles.title: Japan's prime minister says her policies will boost confidence in the yen after U.S. intervention falls short
articles.description: Japan's Prime Minister said her government's policies will lift confidence in the yen, following underwhelming success in prior efforts to boost the currency.

articles.title: Synthetic tokenized stocks are bad for American investors
articles.description: U.S. markets are the envy of the world because investors trust that whoever owns a share owns it fully, writes Aaron Kaplan, founder of Promethum. The synthetic models cheapens that trust, shortchanges U.S. investors, and undercuts the issuer-led capital markets model.

articles.title: Bargain Britain lures foreign buyers as hostile takeovers surge
articles.description: International capital is driving a surge in public takeovers in the G7’s fastest-growing economy.

articles.title: Tokenized assets don’t always mirror traditional markets, Dune finds
articles.description: Dune found that tokenized markets show different trading patterns from traditional markets, with RWA value reaching $34.5 billion.

articles.title: Bitcoin kicks off new quarter in the old $82,000-$85,000 price range
articles.description: Prices briefly topped $85,000 on Wednesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation cooled bets on Fed rate hikes, But bulls couldn’t hold the move and spot ETFs didn’t help.

articles.title: Bitcoin trapped below $86K as PCE changes cloud inflation reading
articles.description: Bitcoin erased its post-PCE gains as analysts cautioned that methodology changes complicated the lower-than-expected inflation reading.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
articles.description: Treasury yields were higher on Thursday amid a global sell-off in government debt.

articles.title: Binance’s EU services face scrutiny over licensing exemption: Report
articles.description: EU regulators are reportedly examining Binance’s use of a MiCA exemption to serve customers as ESMA seeks stronger enforcement powers.

articles.title: Citigroup raises 12-month bitcoin target to $113,000 as ETF inflows resume
articles.description: Citi also raised its 12-month target for ether from from $2,240 to $3,028.

articles.title: Russia launches massive strikes on Ukraine’s energy grid, forcing power cuts ahead of winter
articles.description: Seven people were killed in the attack and emergency power cuts were imposed in Kyiv and three other regions.

articles.title: MetaMask Exits Lido Validators Amid Infrastructure ‘Security Incident’
articles.description: The wallet says it has found no immediate threat to user wallets, but the ETH it is pulling out of Lido could take 45 days to return.

articles.title: Chainalysis beats most Celsius claims, but ‘audit’ lawsuit survives
articles.description: Chainalysis still faces an aiding-and-abetting claim over Celsius’ disputed $3.3 billion audit after a judge dismissed 15 other claims.

articles.title: EU Presses Binance Over ‘Reverse Solicitation’ Exemption for Users: Report
articles.description: Regulators are probing how the exchange keeps serving EU customers from Abu Dhabi, months after it lost its MiCA registrations.

articles.title: The U.S. just made it much easier for retail investors to access private markets
articles.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved new plans to open private markets up to retail investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
articles.description: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.

articles.title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
articles.description: An Ethereum security researcher estimates about 0.36 ETH in rewards was diverted, while precautionary exits cover validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH.

articles.title: Bitcoin think tank questions MSCI’s ‘invisible committee’ over Strategy, Metaplanet rule
articles.description: A Bitcoin Policy Institute paper says MSCI’s proposed “non-operating company” rule could remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes and may have roots in an earlier crypto treasury review.
